title: Mini handoff needle map - Feb 2029
summary: Compact, ad-hoc tracker used to triage owner handoffs and weekend surge coverage for a 72-hour window. Focus is on low-friction swaps, immediate contact routing, and a single line of mitigation per item. Not intended to be canonical — portable snapshot for async shuffles.
purpose: Quickly identify fragile ownership touchpoints (models/routes/infra) and give on-call/ops a minimal set of fallbacks and actions for the upcoming weekend surge and a small promo burst on Feb 17-18.

Pre-stage small-8bit variant to serving pool and verify warm cache (check conformance tests)

quick_risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Kernel regression causes token latency spikes. Mitigation: route to llm-small-8bit; add temporary rate limit for non-critical routes.
Risk: Prefix cache corruption during long sequences. Mitigation: scheduled cache purge at 2029-02-17T02:00Z and increase cache-health sampling to 1m.
Risk: Burst capacity overcommit. Mitigation: pre-reserve minimal reserved-burst-spot and enable graceful-fallback policy to regional-hosted-api
notes_to_self: Keep this file focused on immediate 72h window — do not fold long-term capacity planning here.
If handoff requires >1hr sync, create a follow-up Confluence page and link it in linked_artifacts.
Use the item ID in future postmortems to trace decisions (prefix 3-digit)
